{{Attr|Slime}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Korblox Seeker''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Classic Event]]. It had a low amount of health and an average speed. On certain waves, it could spawn as a [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] enemy, meaning all sorts of damage only dealt one damage to it. ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Seeker''' had blue skin. It wore a black shirt, pants and hood. It had an arm-pad and knee-pad on its right arm and leg, with some blue neon spikes. It did not have a left arm and leg, exposing its skeleton. ==Strategy== *The [[Militant]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective against the '''Korblox Seeker''', as their quick firerate allows them to kill it even while it is a tank. *Towers like the [[Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Accelerator]] can be effective at clearing these out at later waves. *The [[Commander]] can be quite useful if available, as it can allow your towers to deal more damage to the '''Korblox Seeker''', which can be useful when it is a tank. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxSeekerWalk.gif|Walking animation (23 May 2024 – 12 March 2025) }} ==Update History== *'''23 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0]] **'''Korblox Seeker''' added. *'''28 May 2024''' - [[v1.23.0|v1.23.3]] **'''Korblox Seeker''' removed. *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Korblox Seeker''' re-added. *'''12 March 2025''' - [[v1.57.0]] **'''Korblox Seeker''' removed. {{ClassicWinter|Start|N/A|Korblox Seeker & [[Korblox Guard (The Classic)|Korblox Guard]]|Wave 1|[[Korblox Undead (The Classic)|Korblox Undead]]|Wave 2}} {{ClassicIslandChaos|Start|N/A|[[Korblox Guard (The Classic)|Korblox Guard]] & Korblox Seeker|Wave 1|[[Korblox Undead (The Classic)|Korblox Undead]]|Wave 2}} {{ClassicCastle|[[Korblox Undead (The Classic)|Korblox Undead]] & [[Normal Boss]]|Wave 3|Korblox Seeker & [[Breaker2]]|Wave 4|[[Korblox Soul (The Classic)|Korblox Soul]] & [[Korblox Warrior (The Classic)|Korblox Warrior]]|Wave 5}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Korblox Seeker}}
